⚡ 8 Transformation Priorities

1. Predictive Maintenance Overhaul

Shift from calendar-based to condition-based maintenance. Predict component failures before they happen. Reduce unplanned maintenance by 40%.

2. Crew Manning Optimisation

Real-time crew availability modelling. Reduce gap-to-sea rate. Optimise draft management. Ensure specialist qualification coverage.

3. Ammunition State Awareness

Real-time ammunition stockpile visibility across the fleet. Predict consumption rates for operations. Automate NATO STANAG reporting.

4. Fuel Efficiency Programme

Model consumption patterns. Optimise bunkering schedules. Plan alternative fuel transition. Reduce carbon intensity per nautical mile.

5. Digital Ship Integration

Unified ship-to-shore data backbone. Combat system data fusion. Edge AI capability. Cyber-resilient architecture.

6. Readiness Scoring Standardisation

Common readiness scoring framework across all vessel classes. Automated OST compliance. Real-time capability declaration.

7. Logistics Chain Visibility

End-to-end supply chain transparency. Forward logistics prediction. Emergency resupply automation.

8. Parliamentary Transparency

Real-time fleet strength dashboard. Readiness trend reporting. Capability delivery metrics. Defence spending accountability.

🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No vessel declared operational-for-tasking without verified crew complement, ammunition state, and maintenance certification
  • ❌ No maintenance deferral without risk assessment, commanding officer sign-off, and safety impact analysis
  • ❌ No crew deployment without verified training currency, medical clearance, and watch system compliance
  • ❌ No ammunition embarkation without magazine safety certification and NATO STANAG compliance verification
  • ❌ No operational certification granted without full OST compliance and training milestone completion
  • ❌ No fleet readiness data shared outside classification boundaries without explicit authority and data handling protocol

🤝 5-Step Engagement Model

1
Discovery: Map fleet readiness maturity. Assess maintenance governance. Benchmark crew manning. Identify readiness gaps.
2
Governance Design: Deploy DEFONEOS MCP servers against fleet readiness use cases. Configure maintenance and crew protocols. Establish readiness governance.
3
Pilot: Run 90-day pilot across 1 carrier strike group and 1 amphibious task group. Measure readiness uplift. Collect crew and maintainer feedback.
4
Scale: Roll out across all Royal Navy fleet operations. Integrate with Navy Digital platform. Deploy across all vessel classes.
5
Assure: Continuous audit-grade fleet readiness governance reporting. Readiness transparency. Parliamentary evidence generation. Defence capability metrics.
